about: The text of Prepare an Evening Request (Apple) and Share Evening Request (Android), built on the device by CaveKit (EveningRequestTests.swift) and the Android core (EveningRequestTest.kt). Each case gives the request (occasion, bottlesWanted: null or 0 lets the assistant choose and more than 24 means 24, onlyReady, language en or fr, year, omitted: wines left out) and its wines in order (style and maturity use the English words of Get Cellar Contents; appellation is the region when the wine has none); text is the whole request. Prices, notes, places of purchase and photos are never in it.

cases.about: English, an occasion and a number of bottles, only bottles ready to drink
cases.occasion: Dinner for 6 with a tagine, friends who like Loire reds
cases.text:
Help me choose wine from my cellar for this evening.
Occasion: Dinner for 6 with a tagine, friends who like Loire reds
Propose 3 bottles, taken only from the list below.
For each bottle, say why it fits, when to serve it in the evening (order of service), its serving temperature and where it is in the cellar (its position).
The list holds only bottles ready to drink or to drink soon.
Answer in English.

My cellar in 2026: 2 wines, 3 bottles.
Columns: wine | producer | style | appellation | window | maturity | bottles | positions
1. Chinon Les Picasses 2018 | Olga Raffault | red | Chinon | 2022-2026 | drink soon | 2 | Main rack · B3; Main rack · B4
2. Saumur-Champigny 2020 | Clos Rougeard | red | Saumur-Champigny | 2024-2032 | ready | 1 | Cabinet · Shelf 2, position 3
